about: Form cues for the exercise sheet (SPEC 4.4). Written by hand from the source instructions in data/catalog.json, never invented. Each cue is under 12 words and lists the source instruction lines it came from (0 based). watchOut only where a source line names the mistake.

cues.text: Start with dumbbells at upper chest, palms facing you.
Press up, turning your palms to face forward.
Lower, turning your palms back toward you.
Stand tall, shoulder width grip, elbows close to your body.
Curl the bar to shoulder level; only your forearms move.
Lower the bar slowly back down.

Barbell_Curl.goodFor: Builds the biceps, the front of the upper arm.

cues.text: Grip the bar shoulder width, back as straight as possible.
Push with your legs as your torso comes upright.
Bend knees and hips to lower; keep your back straight.

Barbell_Deadlift.goodFor: Builds the whole back side: legs, hips and back.

cues.text: Sit against a bench, bar rolled over your hips.
Shoulder blades rest near the top of the bench.
Drive through your feet and push your hips up.

Barbell_Hip_Thrust.goodFor: Builds the glutes; a pad on the bar makes it comfier.

cues.text: Lie on an incline bench, bar straight over you.
Lower slowly until the bar touches your upper chest.
Press back up; take twice as long going down.

Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri.goodFor: Builds the upper chest and the front of the shoulders.

cues.text: Bar across the back of your shoulders, just below the neck.
Head up, back straight, toes slightly out.
Sit down to just below parallel, then push through your heels.

watchOut.text: Knees stay in line with your toes.

cues.text: Bend forward until your back is almost flat, knees soft.
Pull the bar to you, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly.

watchOut.text: Keep your back straight and your torso still.

Bent_Over_Barbell_Row.goodFor: Builds the middle back and lats.

cues.text: Back flat on the pad, upper arms level with the floor.
Push the handles together slowly and squeeze your chest.
Open back slowly until your chest is stretched.
Rope on the low pulley, hands straight above your head.
Keep elbows close to your head; lower the rope behind it.
Straighten your arms back up using your triceps.

Cable_Rope_Overhead_Triceps_Extension.goodFor: Builds the triceps, the back of the upper arm.

cues.text: Balls of your feet low on the platform, heels off.
Push the platform by raising your heels as high as possible.
Lower your heels slowly until your calves stretch.

watchOut.text: Keep your knees still; do not bend them.

cues.text: Knee pad snug, hands closer than shoulder width.
Lean back slightly, chest up.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, then return slowly.

watchOut.text: Keep your upper body still; only your arms move.

Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown.goodFor: Builds the lats, the wide muscles of the back.

cues.text: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands lightly by your head.
Press your lower back down and lift your shoulders.
Squeeze for a second, then lower slowly.

watchOut.text: Move slowly; do not use momentum.

Crunches.goodFor: Works the abs; needs no equipment.

cues.text: On your back, arms up, hips and knees at 90 degrees.
Breathe out and press your lower back into the floor.
Straighten one leg just above the floor, then switch.

watchOut.text: Do not let your lower back arch.

Dead_Bug.goodFor: Trains the abs to keep your back steady.

cues.text: Lie flat, dumbbells at the sides of your chest.
Push the dumbbells up and squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly, about twice as long as going up.

Dumbbell_Bench_Press.goodFor: Builds the chest, front shoulders and triceps.

cues.text: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms facing you.
Lift your shoulders as high as you can, hold a second.
Lower the dumbbells back down.

watchOut.text: Keep your arms straight; only your shoulders move.

Dumbbell_Shrug.goodFor: Builds the traps, the muscles between neck and shoulders.

cues.text: Bar on the front of your shoulders, elbows high.
Head up, back straight, toes slightly out.
Sit down below parallel, then push through mid foot.

watchOut.text: Knees stay in line with your toes.

Front_Barbell_Squat.goodFor: Builds the front of the thighs.

cues.text: Stand tall, dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise them forward to just above shoulder height.
Lower slowly back down.

watchOut.text: Keep your body still; no swinging.

Front_Two-Dumbbell_Raise.goodFor: Builds the front of the shoulders.

cues.text: Hold the weight close to your chest.
Squat down deep, chest and head up, back straight.
At the bottom, push your knees out with your elbows.

Goblet_Squat.goodFor: Builds the legs and teaches a good squat with one weight.

cues.text: Ankles under the pads, thighs flat on the wide pad.
Bend forward slowly at the waist, back flat.
Rise back up slowly to a straight line.

watchOut.text: Never round your back, and do not swing.

Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions.goodFor: Builds the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.

cues.text: Band at elbow height, elbow pressed to your side.
Elbow bent to 90 degrees, hand reaching out.
Rotate your forearm in across your body, then return.

watchOut.text: Keep your elbow in place against your side.

Internal_Rotation_with_Band.goodFor: Strengthens the small muscles that turn the shoulder.

cues.text: Lie flat, arms straight behind your head, legs straight.
Lift your arms and legs to meet above you.
Lower both back to the start.

Jackknife_Sit-Up.goodFor: Works the abs; needs no equipment.

cues.text: Pad on your lower shins, knees at 90 degrees.
Straighten your legs fully, pause a second.
Lower slowly, no further than 90 degrees.

watchOut.text: Keep the rest of your body still on the seat.

Leg_Extensions.goodFor: Builds the quads, the front of the thighs.

cues.text: Feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower slowly until your knees reach 90 degrees.
Push through your heels back up.

watchOut.text: Do not lock your knees at the top.

Leg_Press.goodFor: Builds the legs with your back supported.

cues.text: Lie face down, pad just under your calves.
Curl your legs up as far as possible, hold a second.
Lower back to straight legs.

watchOut.text: Keep your upper legs flat on the pad.

Lying_Leg_Curls.goodFor: Builds the hamstrings, the back of the thighs.

cues.text: Feet close together on the platform, toes slightly out.
Lower slowly until your knees reach 90 degrees.
Push through your heels back up.

watchOut.text: Do not lock your knees at the top.

Narrow_Stance_Leg_Press.goodFor: Builds the front of the thighs with your back supported.

cues.text: One knee and hand on the bench, back flat.
Pull the dumbbell up to the side of your chest.
Lower it straight down, then switch sides.

watchOut.text: Keep your torso still; pull with your back.

One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.goodFor: Builds the back one side at a time.

cues.text: Upper arm flat on the preacher pad.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Curl up and squeeze, then switch arms.

One_Arm_Dumbbell_Preacher_Curl.goodFor: Builds the biceps without help from the body.

cues.text: Forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders.
Up on your toes, body in one straight line.
Hold as long as you can.

Plank.goodFor: Trains the abs to hold your body steady.

cues.text: Hang from the bar, palms facing forward.
Chest up, pull until the bar reaches your upper chest.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

Pullups.goodFor: Builds the back and arms with just your bodyweight.

cues.text: Seat set so the handles are at shoulder height.
Pull your hands out and back in a wide arc.
Arms slightly bent; pause, then return slowly.

Reverse_Machine_Flyes.goodFor: Builds the back of the shoulders; good for posture.

cues.text: Knees slightly bent, shins vertical, back straight.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back.
Stand up with your hips, steady and controlled.

watchOut.text: Keep your back and arms straight the whole time.

cues.text: One rope end in each hand, rope behind you.
Swing it over your head and jump as it lands.
Find a pace you can keep going.

Rope_Jumping.goodFor: Gets your heart going and trains coordination.

cues.text: Feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
Sit upright, chest out, arms straight.
Pull the handle to your belly, squeeze, return slowly.

watchOut.text: Keep your torso still as you pull.

cues.text: Toes on the platform edge, heels hanging off.
Lower your heels slowly until your calves stretch.
Raise your heels as high as possible, hold a second.

Seated_Calf_Raise.goodFor: Builds the calves, mostly the lower part.

cues.text: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to the side until arms are level.
Lower slowly back down.

watchOut.text: Keep your body still; no swinging.

Side_Lateral_Raise.goodFor: Builds the side of the shoulders for a wider look.

cues.text: Overhand grip on the bar, hands shoulder width.
Lead with your elbows; lift the bar close to your body.
Stop near your chin, pause, lower slowly.

watchOut.text: Keep your elbows higher than your forearms.

cues.text: Grip a little wider than shoulders, bar on your collarbone.
Feet shoulder width; press the bar overhead.
Lower slowly to your collarbone, then press again.

Standing_Military_Press.goodFor: Builds the shoulders and overhead strength.

cues.text: Hold the low pulley handle, elbow at your side.
Curl the handle up; only your forearm moves.
Squeeze, lower, then switch arms.

Standing_One-Arm_Cable_Curl.goodFor: Builds the biceps one arm at a time.

cues.text: Hold one dumbbell straight up over your head.
Keep your elbow by your head; lower it behind.
Straighten your arm back up, then switch arms.

watchOut.text: Keep your upper arm still; only the forearm moves.

Standing_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extens.goodFor: Builds the triceps, the back of the upper arm.

cues.text: Overhand grip, feet shoulder width, knees slightly bent.
Bend at the hips until your hamstrings stretch.
Stand back up by pushing your hips forward.

watchOut.text: Keep your back straight and your knees still.

Stiff-Legged_Barbell_Deadlift.goodFor: Builds the hamstrings and lower back.

cues.text: Sit on the machine and hold the side handles.
Push your legs apart slowly.
Hold a second, then bring them back.

watchOut.text: Keep your upper body still.

cues.text: Sit on the machine and hold the side handles.
Squeeze your legs together slowly.
Hold a second, then let them open.

watchOut.text: Keep your upper body still; no jerking.

cues.text: Bar on the high pulley, overhand grip, elbows at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Hold a second, then let it rise slowly.

watchOut.text: Keep your upper arms still; only forearms move.

Triceps_Pushdown.goodFor: Builds the triceps, the back of the upper arm.

cues.text: Knee pad snug, hands wider than shoulder width.
Lean back slightly, chest up.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, then return slowly.

watchOut.text: Keep your upper body still; only your arms move.

Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.goodFor: Builds the lats, the wide muscles of the back.
